test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In an examination, there are four subjects of 100 marks each. A student scores 78% in the first subject, 75% in the second subject and 90% in the third subject. She scored 85% in aggregate. Her percentage of marks in the fourth subject is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Let marks in 4th subject = x

Agrigate marks = sum of marks of all subject / 4

85 = (78 + 75 + 90 + x)/4

85 × 4 = 243 + x

x = 340 - 243 = 97

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marks in first subject = 78% of 100 = 78

Marks in second subject = 75% of 100 = 75

Marks in third subject = 90% of 100 = 90

Aggregate percentage = 85%

Total marks of all four subjects = 4 × 100 = 400

**Formula Used:**

Aggregate percentage = (Total marks obtained / Total marks) × 100

**Calculation:**

Total marks obtained = Aggregate percentage × Total marks / 100

Total marks obtained = 85 × 400 / 100

Total marks obtained = 340

Marks in fourth subject = Total marks obtained - (Marks in first subject + Marks in second subject + Marks in third subject)

Marks in fourth subject = 340 - (78 + 75 + 90)

Marks in fourth subject = 340 - 243

Marks in fourth subject = 97

Percentage of marks in the fourth subject = (Marks in fourth subject / 100) × 100

Percentage of marks in the fourth subject = 97%

**The correct answer is option 2.**
